turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My partner snores and I'm waking up three times a night.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's rough. Do you want to try earplugs or a white noise machine first, or talk to your partner about seeing a doctor?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The budget's around— oh, hi! Moshi, give me a minute, my friend's here.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Chloe, how do you share your location with someone? Mum wants to see when I'm driving home.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Open the map app, tap your little picture, then share location. You pick how long.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I make it just for tonight?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, there's an option for one hour or until you turn it off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll do until I turn it off. Otherwise I'll forget and she'll panic halfway down the motorway.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Classic. Send it to me too while you're at it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Um, okay, yeah, I'm back. Sorry. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. So, a quick fix, or the doctor idea?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, I'm a slow reader and it embarrasses me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lots of people read slowly, and there's nothing wrong with it. Slow readers often notice details fast readers miss.
